spec.name: Furniture Oak Chair
spec.description: Warm oak dining chair with four sturdy legs, three short back slats, mortise-style joinery and an oatmeal linen cushion. Cushion top is exactly y=14; the compact back reaches y=16. All geometry fits within one block, faces negative Z and remains connected.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: warm oak dining chair with four legs and slatted back. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges. Seat cushion top must be at y=14 so a player can sit on it. Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
